title: Oven-Roasted Slovakian Popcorn Pudding
description: A rich, buttery pudding that marries caramelized popcorn with a silky custard, baked to perfection in a water bath for a lazy Sunday treat.
instructions: In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat and add popcorn kernels, covering the skillet and shaking until the popping slows, then transfer the kernels to a baking sheet.
Sprinkle brown sugar, sea salt, and ground cinnamon over the kernels and toss until all are evenly coated.
Roast the coated popcorn in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, stirring halfway through, until the kernels are caramelized and crisp.
While the popcorn roasts, combine milk, cream, honey, vanilla extract, and ground nutmeg in a saucepan, heating until warm but not boiling.
In a separate bowl, whisk eggs and cornstarch until smooth, then gradually pour the warm milk mixture into the bowl, whisking continuously to prevent curdling.
Pour the custard into a heatproof dish and place it in a larger pan filled with 2 inches of hot water for a bain‑marie, then bake for 30 minutes in the oven.
Remove the dish from the water bath, let it cool for 5 minutes, and fold in the roasted popcorn until it is evenly distributed.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes to set the custard and toast the popcorn further, then let cool to room temperature before serving.
